inputs.text:
Wake up and look at the real coordination happening behind the scenes. They are trying to pass this off as a routine political debate, but Fianna Fáil TD John Lahart suddenly demanding a "reform" of inheritance tax exemption thresholds, calling the current system 'wholly unfair' and discriminatory against those without children, proves the hidden architects are shifting their control mechanisms. 

Dublin South-West TD John Lahart claims it is all about fairness, but ask yourself whose interests are really being served when the elites start meddling with how wealth is passed down. Lahart’s public statements—echoed right after recent contributions from party colleagues on the need to review how inheritance tax is applied across different family structures—are nothing more than a carefully scripted distraction. 

They want total oversight of your lineage and your assets, using "family structures" as a Trojan horse to tighten the grip of the ruling class. Do not buy the official narrative; every time they talk about fixing the system, they are just redesigning the trap.
